CreateInstance.clientToken: Ensures request idempotency; ASCII characters only, max 64 characters
CreateInstance.name: BCI instance name (container group name), 2-252 characters, alphanumeric, "-" or ".", must start and end with alphanumeric
CreateInstance.securityGroupIds: Security group IDs; all security groups and subnets must belong to the same VPC; max 10
CreateInstance.subnetIds: Subnet IDs; must belong to the same VPC, no duplicates; max 10
CreateInstance.autoCreateEip: Whether to automatically create and bind an EIP; takes effect only when eipIp is empty; default false
CreateInstance.eipName: Elastic public IP name; takes effect when autoCreateEip is true; default "eip"
CreateInstance.eipRouteType: EIP line type: BGP (standard) or BGP_S (enhanced); default BGP
CreateInstance.eipBandwidthInMbps: Public bandwidth (Mbps); standard BGP 1-500, enhanced BGP 100-5000; traffic-billed standard BGP 1-200; default 100
CreateInstance.eipBillingMethod: Billing method: ByTraffic (by traffic, default), ByBandwidth (by bandwidth), ByPeak95 (by enhanced 95th percentile)
CreateInstance.gpuType: GPU model; currently only Nvidia A10 PCIE is supported
CreateInstance.tags.tagKey: Tag key; alphanumeric, "-", or "."; must start and end with alphanumeric
CreateInstance.containers.name: Container name, 1-40 characters, alphanumeric, "-" or "."
CreateInstance.containers.memory: Memory (GiB); must not exceed total instance memory
CreateInstance.containers.cpu: CPU (cores); must not exceed total instance CPU cores
CreateInstance.containers.gpu: Number of GPUs allocated to the container
CreateInstance.containers.imagePullPolicy: Image pull policy: Always, IfNotPresent, Never
CreateInstance.containers.stdin: Whether to allocate a stdin buffer; default false
CreateInstance.containers.stdinOnce: Whether to keep stdin open across multiple sessions; default false
CreateInstance.containers.tty: Whether to enable TTY (required for /bin/bash); default false
CreateInstance.initContainers.name: Container name, 1-40 characters, alphanumeric, "-" or "."
CreateInstance.initContainers.memory: Memory (GiB); must not exceed total instance memory
CreateInstance.initContainers.cpu: CPU (cores); must not exceed total instance CPU cores
CreateInstance.initContainers.gpu: Number of GPUs allocated to the container
CreateInstance.initContainers.imagePullPolicy: Image pull policy: Always, IfNotPresent, Never
CreateInstance.initContainers.stdin: Whether to allocate a stdin buffer; default false
CreateInstance.initContainers.stdinOnce: Whether to keep stdin open across multiple sessions; default false
CreateInstance.initContainers.tty: Whether to enable TTY (required for /bin/bash); default false
CreateInstance.volume: Volume configuration; names must be unique, lowercase alphanumeric or "-"
